connector.name: Paradex Trading
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Paradex perp trading. Market data, accounts, orders, positions, and vaults.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-paradex. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tradeparadex account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: PARADEX_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Ethereum private key for your Paradex account (enables trading). Without this, only public market data is accessible.

env.name: PARADEX_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Paradex environment to connect to. Defaults to 'prod'. Use 'testnet' for testing.
